title: Ruthless Cherry Drank Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Cherry Drank is a flavour-packed e-liquid that plays with the idea of a classic Cherry flavour with hints of the rich, sugary taste of sweet cherry confectionary colliding with the effervescent fizz of a bubbly cherry soda. This indulgent blend offers a deep, syrupy fruitiness with a playful, fizzy undertone, making it a great choice for those who enjoy bold and nostalgic flavours. Part of the renowned Ruthless Shortfill range, Cherry Drank is crafted with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio for dense, satisfying vapour production and a smooth, rounded flavour. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and more powerful advanced vape kits, it is supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your nicotine strength to suit your preference. Ruthless is one of the pioneers of American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have influenced the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills continue to be a favourite among vapers looking for high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in e-liquid.
